question: In December 2020, which of the following State Governments gave permission to hold the popular bull taming sport Jallikattu with certain restrictions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Tamil Nadu government had granted permission to organise a Jallikattu event, subject to certain conditions.**
 
• At an event, the number of players must not exceed 150, and players must have a COVID-19 negative certificate.
 
• The number of spectators not to be more than 50% of the gathering.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• **Jallikkattu:**

 
 
• **A traditional bull-taming sport in the state is conducted during the Pongal festival.**
 
• **Location: Madurai district, Tamil Nadu**
 
• However, the sport had faced a ban after protests by the Animal Welfare Board of India and animal rights organisation PETA.
 
• Following widespread protests in the state in 2016, the Tamil Nadu government passed an ordinance, which, with Centre’s approval, allowed it to resume in 2017. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**State**__
 __**Festivals**__
 
 

 Andhra Pradesh
 Flamingo Festival, Srivari Brahmotsavam Festival, Visakha Utsav
 
 

 Karnataka
 Kambala Festival, Karaga Festival, Mahamastakabhisheka Festival, Vairamudi Brahmotsava Festival
 
 

 **Tamil Nadu**
 **Pongal, Puthandu Festival, Chapparam Festival, Mahamaham Festival**
 
 

 Kerala
 Onam, Makaravilakku Festival, Vishu Festival, Theyyam Festival
